questions.prompt: According to the provided material, what is the primary purpose of a Minimum Viable Product (MVP)?
options: To launch a fully-featured product to the market as quickly as possible.
To collect the maximum amount of validated learning about customers with the least effort.
To create a perfect, bug-free version of the product before showing it to users.
To generate the highest possible revenue in the first month of launch.
questions.correctAnswer: To collect the maximum amount of validated learning about customers with the least effort.
questions.explanation: Slide 27: The material provides a direct quote from Eric Ries defining an MVP: “A minimum viable product is that version of a new product which allows a team to collect the maximum amount of validated learning about customers with the least effort.”

questions.prompt: Based on the "Lean startup program" slide, which of the following are listed as its core components? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Slide 26: The slide explicitly lists three components for the Lean startup program: Business model canvas, Customer development process, and Agile development.
